description: This file defines the GatewayRemoteConfig enum which contains static methods for resolving and normalizing remote gateway configurations, including transport type, URL, token values, and URL normalization in the context of a remote gateway setup.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport type (direct or ssh) from a nested dictionary representing JSON configuration.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from a nested configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Resolves the token value, determining if it is missing, non-string, or a plaintext token.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Retrieves the token string if available, otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Returns a normalized URL object for the gateway URL if valid.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into an absolute URL string if valid and normalized.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by enforcing schemes and ports for WebSocket protocols and validates it.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Provides a default port based on the URL's scheme if none is specified.
